title: Sleeping on the boat and the first Monday night in St. Louis
summary: Russell asks whether the men slept on the boat; Manetta recounts arriving and playing a colored Monday-night job.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: When you were on the boat... Huh? Excuse me. When you were on the boat, you all had rooms in St. Louis too. You didn't live...
You didn't sleep on the boat. Well, no. I'll tell you. We didn't stay long enough. I was on the boat. You stayed...
You slept on the boat then? I told you. See?

Well, you... That's the first time. Yeah, you see. I got there in the morning... In the morning. In the morning. At night. We played. We played for a colored job. That's crazy. That was on a Monday night. Yeah.
Every Monday, that happened. And the next guy was white.
Well, anyhow, this father leads me.
He wouldn't say nothing to me.
